description.value: Donair Town is a family-run Lebanese fast-food restaurant that has been serving the Greater Vancouver area since 1993, specializing in chicken, beef, and lamb donairs alongside plates and Middle Eastern appetizers like falafel, hummus, and tzatziki. It operates four Lower Mainland locations, with the Clarke Road unit in Coquitlam being one of the original outposts. A touring cyclist passing through Coquitlam would find a filling, protein-rich meal with online and phone ordering available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: building (covered, paid) at 88m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 93m. Total: 10 spaces.
